title: W17 Mac references: the sidebar's row menus (tab, pinned tab, folder, favorite)
about: The context menus of a Today tab, a drifted pinned tab, a folder and a favorite (SidebarListCells.swift's TabRowCell and FolderRowCell contextMenu(at:), SidebarFavorites.swift's FavoritePaneView menu(for:), all shown by showSidebarMenu) for helix/W17-context-menus. Kite for Mac from origin/main: W17 changes no Mac code. The sessions are windows/helix/states on origin/main (pages on example.com/.org/.net/.edu and the favorites' public sites). Under KITE_TEST_CONTEXT_MENU a menu is logged, not shown, so a menu's reference is its logged line (NOTES.md's 'Logged by the test hooks'), which Windows prints in the same format (Kite.exe --capture … --row-menu N / --favorite-menu N, and kitecore menu). The rest states give the sidebar each menu opens over. Every menu state is skipped: a right-click must start on a SAFE_TARGETS view, and TabRowCell, FolderRowCell and FavoritePaneView aren't in it; each skip names the click it would make, and 'widening' below is the smallest change that would allow them (not made here: it needs the script's safety review).
widening: Add a RIGHT_CLICK_TARGETS="TabRowCell FolderRowCell FavoritePaneView" list to scripts/mac-reference-captures.sh, accepted only for {"button": "right"} clicks (never left clicks, drags or modifier flags) in a state whose env has KITE_TEST_CONTEXT_MENU exactly "1" (log only, nothing picked, so no item runs and the store doesn't change). Read in the Mac source: TabRowCell and FolderRowCell inherit SidebarRowCell.rightMouseDown, which calls menu(for:) (acceptsPress, then contextMenu(at:): TabRowCell's tab menu, or GroupHeaderView.groupMenu above a Tidy Tabs header; FolderRowCell's folder menu, or addLiveFolderItems for a live folder) and showSidebarMenu; FavoritePaneView.rightMouseDown calls menu(for:) and showSidebarMenu. showSidebarMenu returns before NSMenu.popUpContextMenu whenever PageContextMenuItems.testMode is set (KITE_TEST_CONTEXT_MENU non-empty on a KITE_SUPPORT_PATH profile), logs the menu, and runs an item only when testPick() names one, which "1" never does. Building the menus touches only the store's state (TabAudioButton, LiveFoldersController.shared's isRefreshing, the spaces for Move to): no window, panel, network or pasteboard. Left clicks on these views stay refused: TabRowCell.tapped selects a tab (loads a page), FolderRowCell.tapped opens or closes a folder, a second press renames.
